subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Color Contrast Testing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Color Contrast Testing.

hook.text: Light gray text on a white background. The designer loves it. A user with low vision can't read a single word.

buildup.text: WCAG requires a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.

discovery.text: Contrast checkers measure the luminance ratio between foreground and background colors automatically.

twist.text: Contrast applies beyond text: icons, form borders, and focus indicators all need sufficient contrast.

climax.text: A site-wide contrast audit finds 23 elements below the ratio. Fixing them takes two days and helps everyone.

punchline.text: If users can't see it, it doesn't exist. Check contrast ratios.

quiz.question: What is the minimum WCAG contrast ratio for normal text?
